dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}! And hello, Paimon! Welcome to the Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots booth. Would you like to experience the basic tutorial?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, a special tutorial? How thoughtful!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Aino created this tutorial because she wanted people to not only gain a solid understanding of how the Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots work, but also to have a good time trying them out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Aino's putting that much thought and effort into this, she must really be proud of her creations...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Please get ready. The tutorial is about to begin.

choices.text: I still have things to do...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Understood. Feel free to come back and continue with the tutorial at any time. I will be waiting for you.
